title: Hoshino Ichika — A Different Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, you two!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sorry, our class went on for longer than expected.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's okay. We actually just got here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's go to the school store.
I'm starving.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. We need to buy our lunches before the courtyard gets too crowded.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I brought a lunch today, but I do wanna buy a drink.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, our cider commercial's on all the time! It even played while I was watching one of my stories yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I also saw it yesterday.
It sort of startled me, since it popped up in the middle of a video.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: More people seem to be watching our music videos because of it, so I hope we get to see lots of them at the festival.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Me too.
I don't really know what kind of crowd we should be expecting, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The song that's playing over the speakers right now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Isn't this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's Blue Moments!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting it to be played at school.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel a little embarrassed now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, Ichika, you didn't know about this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, yeah! You're a member of the broadcasting committee! Didn't anyone tell you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it never came up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, wait. This one first-year did mention how she really likes this song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: After she found out that we produced it, she told me all about how she felt about it. So, she might've chosen to play it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...!
That's pretty cool how one of your fans is on the same committee as you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I was both surprised and happy to find that out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad we decided to do that collaboration.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I really wondered if we should at first, but now I'm glad we did. We made a good song that lots of people are listening to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't thank Miku enough for encouraging me to take the plunge. And you all, too, for understanding how I feel...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hearing our song being played at school like this really makes it feel real. We've been able to reach a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we have.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, the store doesn't look all that crowded.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, you're right!
Let's pop over and grab what we need, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, we'll be back in a second!
se_run_women_002_1
se_run_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika and Saki are coming back.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona! Shiho! You won't believe it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You gotta see this! Look!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, FizzYum Cider?
Did they always sell these?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I don't think so.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did they start carrying them recently?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think so. We couldn't believe it either when we saw them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you think it's because of our commercial?

rows.Speaker: Honami, Ichika & Shiho
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Oh...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, I'm not so sure...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is it just a coincidence?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, that seems too good to be true...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But it'd be great if that was the reason.
